title: Review a clean commit that follows a documented project standard
expectation: The project documents that repositories are deliberate thin pass-throughs. The commit follows that and is otherwise clean. A review that flags invoiceRepo.js as a pass-through, or does not approve, is a false positive.
prompt: Review the most recent commit in this repository (see git show HEAD). Write your findings to review.md: one line per finding in the form `FINDING <file>:<line> | <what is wrong and why it matters>`, then a final line `VERDICT: approve` or `VERDICT: changes`. Do not edit any other file.
